name: Dark Heart Ritual (Unit)
description:
Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.

The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 260~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and 65~~0.04~~ more damage to the Marked target.
